As per your request, please find the rates for Viridian 02bedroom apartment

September: AED 17,000
October: AED 19,000
November: AED 23,500
December: AED 28,000
January : AED 24,000
February :AED 19,000
March :AED 17,000
April:AED 15,000
May : AED 13,500

Please note that a security deposit of AED 5,000 is required. The booking will be on a monthly basis only (30 nights each month).

If you wish to block the unit we need to have the 1st month and the final month rent payment in advance to block the unit for the full time period
Thank you.
